output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Only 7.4.0 can receive the flag, and 7.4.0 crashes at about 2% versus about 0.7% on 7.3.2. That was already true on 2–3 Sep, before the flag ramp began. The leading crash cluster is a native crash in the upgraded Pixelda image library (HEIF decoding), and it does not occur in 7.3.2. Within 7.4.0, flag-on users (2.10%) and the random flag-off holdout (1.98%) are close, and the difference is within noise. Device mix and usage are about the same across groups. The app-store console, which is independent of Tracewell, shows the same gap, so it isn't a reporting artifact. A small flag effect (up to about 0.3 points) can't be ruled out yet. Turning the flag off and releasing 7.4.0 to 100% would spread the real crash problem to everyone while closing the incident. Hold 7.4.0 at 25%, and fix the Pixelda crash first (check the library upgrade and HEIF decoding). Keep the existing holdout running, and consider widening it to settle the flag question sooner. Don't roll back the crash-reporting SDK. I'm fairly confident, though the Pixelda cause is not directly proven.
